architecture.hexagonal: trusted capture driving adapter → M07 application publication input → recovery policy → RecoveryStore/M05 ports ← native index/catalog adapters
architecture.dependency: M07 application → abstract recovery/material ports; native adapters implement ports; no domain filesystem
architecture.ownership: Source owner owns live capture/baselines; M07 immutable attempt owns payload/index evidence; M05 owns pin/root receipts
architecture.mutation: Only exact current owner can accept captured recovery ACK; live newer capture never overwritten
architecture.transaction: payload/material durable → index CAS → LocalIntegrityReady → separate M05 root transfer → captured source ACK; no catalog/index lease held across owner callback

contracts: LocalIntegrityReady requires payload/index/material proof, independent of original catalog
Index Failed/Unknown cannot transfer or ACK
Root deferred retains Held/Unknown and LocalIntegrityReady; no release
Matching old capture ACK updates captured recovery baseline only; formal/live state unchanged
Stale owner cannot ACK; restart proof loss cannot mint success/retry/release

mapping.fingerprint: evidence.recovery_fingerprint; typed SGA-RECOVERY-FP-v1, never payload raw
mapping.raw: payload_raw_digest vs index prior/new raw vs material digest remain distinct
mapping.transition: UUIDv5(workflow_id, UTF8 transfer-recovery/0); issuer/store/workflow/operation exact key
mapping.proof: M07 ReceiptRef evidence_digest hashes full proposed evidence; M05 external_proof.raw_digest=index committed raw and projection_digest=full evidence hash; adopted issuer schema pending
mapping.request: Full effective CXv3 closed transfer-recovery body, no purpose injection or post-hash enrichment
